find_files.description: Find visible files below a directory. Both arguments are required: path is a normalized Git-style repository-relative directory using / on every operating system, including Windows (use an empty string for the root); pattern uses the same path format relative to path, where * matches one path segment and ** matches any number of segments (use ** for every descendant). Returns at most 200 paths.

grep.description: Search visible UTF-8 text with pagination. pattern, path, and cursor are required: pattern is a Python regular expression of at most 512 characters; path is a repository-relative file or directory and uses an empty string for the repository root; use cursor=0 for the first page and pass a returned next_cursor unchanged to continue. Each page scans at most 1 MiB and returns at most 200 matches.

read_file.description: Read a visible file with required path, inclusive one-based start_line and end_line, and version current|base|head. Read at most 500 lines: current is the verified frozen content and may include the captured overlay; base and head are the pinned Git revisions. Binary files are rejected and output is limited to 64 KiB.

get_diff.description: Read the verified base-to-current diff for one changed visible path. current is frozen Review content and may include the captured workspace overlay, while base is the pinned base revision. Output is limited to 64 KiB.

comment.description: Submit 1 to 20 concrete findings in comments. Every item requires path, side, existing_code, title, content, recommendation, category, severity, and confidence. Use side=old for base-version removed lines shown after - markers, or side=new for target-version added lines shown after + markers. existing_code must quote the smallest exact sequence containing only changed lines on that side, without diff markers. Do not include unchanged diff context. severity is critical|high|medium|low|info and confidence is between 0 and 1.

task_done.description: Finish the investigation exactly once without creating a Finding. summary is required and contains 1 to 8000 characters; reviewed_changed_files is the required number of investigated changed files from 0 to 10000.
